title: NearbyStarsViewer nearest 150 stellar systems
description: The 150 nearest distinct stellar systems selected reproducibly from CNS5.
selectionPolicy: CNS5 rows with trigonometric parallax, retaining single objects and flagged system primaries; sorted by descending parallax and limited to 150 systems.

sources.title: The Fifth Catalogue of Nearby Stars (CNS5)
sources.catalogVersion: Published CNS5 with GAVO corrections through 2023-09-04
sources.acknowledgement: This research has made use of the Fifth Catalogue of Nearby Stars (Golovin et al. 2023) and the GAVO Data Center.

sources.title: NearbyStarsViewer absolute Gaia G magnitude derivation
sources.acknowledgement: Absolute magnitude uses M = m - 5 log10(d_pc) + 5.

sources.title: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems Composite Parameters
sources.publisher: NASA Exoplanet Science Institute / Caltech IPAC
sources.license: NASA Exoplanet Archive public scientific data; PSCompPars DOI 10.26133/NEA13
sources.acknowledgement: This research has made use of the NASA Exoplanet Archive, operated by Caltech under contract with NASA.

sources.title: NearbyStarsViewer inverse-parallax distance derivation
sources.acknowledgement: Distances use d(pc) = 1000 / parallax(mas) and 1 pc = 3.261563777 ly.
